name: s116-test-run-on-test-file-edit
notes: TAN-7039. Writing the test is itself an edit that runs it, and that is where the red bar comes from: a hook watching only source edits would see every test green on its first run and the red-evidence check would fire on all of them. The source column is "-" — this run belongs to the test, not to an edit of some source file.
